tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List / search products
tools.description: Browse the catalog with tag, brand, near_hex (ΔE shade match), hue_family, and sort filters. Bearer becomes required when passing `phone` (rewards projection).

q.description: Natural-language query. Cross-lingual semantic search — `lipstick`, `שפתון`, `lápiz labial` each return Hebrew-tagged lipsticks (the sets may differ across languages but are semantically equivalent). Prefer this over `tag` for any category lookup that isn't already in exact Hebrew.

tag.description: Filter by an EXACT tag string (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed; no translation, no substring). Tags are Hebrew (e.g. שפתון, ביוטי, עיניים, שפתיים). English category names rarely match — use `q` instead for natural-language queries.

brand.description: Filter by brand slug or name.

near_hex.description: Target hex color for ΔE-ranked shade matching. Examples: '#C2185B', 'E8D4B8'. Each returned product carries a `shade_match: {hex, delta_e}` field with the closest variant swatch and its perceptual distance.

hue_family.description: Post-filter on hue family. Must be paired with another filter.

phone.description: E.164 phone for per-customer rewards projection. REQUIRES bearer auth. Omit for anonymous catalog browse.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.title: List all brands
tools.description: Return every brand with product counts and slugs. Bearer required.

tools.name: validate_gift_card
tools.title: Validate a gift card code
tools.description: Check a gift card's remaining balance using its code. Public endpoint — no bearer required (gated on knowledge of the code).

code.description: Gift card code (full string as printed on the card).

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Lookup customer by phone
tools.description: Return tags, ℳ-credit balance, M Club tier for the customer with the given E.164 phone. Bearer required.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.title: Fetch a customer's cart
tools.description: Return the customer's most-recently-updated cart with per-line and total reward projection. Bearer + phone required.

phone.description: E.164 phone selecting the customer whose cart to return.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List a customer's orders
tools.description: Recent orders with 6-axis status (order / payment / fulfillment / delivery / return / review). Bearer + phone required.

tools.name: list_payment_links
tools.title: List pending payment links
tools.description: Pending payment_requests on the customer's unpaid orders. Bearer + phone required.

tools.name: get_customer_best_deals
tools.title: Personalised best deals for a customer
tools.description: Top deal projections based on the customer's tags + M Club tier. Bearer + phone required.
